title: Burnout and Psychological Distress Among Critical Care Nurses: A Nationwide Cross-Sectional Survey
abstract: Background: Healthcare provider burnout is increasingly documented. Methods: A cross-sectional survey design was employed across 45 tertiary centers. Survey questionnaires were completed by 1,450 practicing nurses. Results: In multivariable logistic regression modeling, night-shift assignment was associated with severe burnout (odds ratio, 1.45; 95% CI, 1.12 to 1.88; P = 0.005). Conclusions: Systemic staffing interventions are required.
